messages:
Morgan (sec-eng): Quick planning thread for ACME retest. Need to lock RBAC freeze, KMS window, audit export proof, and evidence presign TTL. Propose retest: Mon May 5 02:00-05:00 UTC. Thoughts?
Priya (compliance): That works. Requesting audit export proof before start and 90d retention. Also prefer presigned TTL = 12h.
Sam (infra): FYI KMS rotations will break existing presigned URLs. We should either use a dedicated alias that won't rotate (pt-evidence) or generate presigned links after any rotation.
Alex (sre): RBAC freeze at 00:00 UTC on test day + emergency change process. We'll provide assume-role flow for external assessors with 8h TTL and log to CloudTrail.
Jamie (oncall): Oncall available. Recommend dry-run to validate presigns, assume-role, and exports. Can do Fri May 2 15:00 UTC (30m).
pt-bot: Evidence bucket created: s3://redwood-pt/acme/retest-2026-05-05. Presigned URL policy set to 12h TTL by default. Audit snapshot scheduled: /exports/pt/acme/2026-05-05.tgz
Morgan (sec-eng): Plan summary: 1) RBAC freeze 00:00 UTC 2) no key rotation during 01:30-02:30 (avoid overlap with exports) 3) presigns generated after rotation OR use pt-evidence alias 4) dry-run on May 2
Priya (compliance): Add streaming of audit logs to compliance bucket and checksum proof attached to evidence room before retest.
Sam (infra): I'll run the export and post checksum. Reminder: need 48h notice to change rotation schedule for key ops.
Alex (sre): I'll add an emergency rollback runbook and ephemeral-override role.
Morgan (sec-eng): I'll spin up JIRA remediation board, mark owners, and publish the runbook after dry-run. If no objections we'll lock schedule tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Priya (compliance): No objections from compliance.
Jamie (oncall): Good from oncall.
Sam (infra): OK pending 48h notice window.
Morgan (sec-eng): Thanks all  tagging action items and closing this sync.
